dashboard_id.description: Only the series of the insights on this dashboard, by numeric id.

date_from.description: Earliest bucket start in the range. A relative date such as `-7d` or `-24h`, or an ISO 8601 date.

date_to.description: Latest bucket start in the range. A relative date or an ISO 8601 date. Defaults to now.

group_by.description:
`series` returns one row per series in `series`. `insight` returns one row per insight in `insights`.

* `series` - Series
* `insight` - Insight

insight_id.description: Only the series of this insight, by numeric id.

interval.description:
Only series with this interval.

* `hour` - Hour
* `day` - Day
* `week` - Week
* `month` - Month

max_anomaly_rate.description: The noise filter: hide flagged series whose anomaly rate over the chart window of their interval is above this share, from 0 to 1. The chart window is the one `include_points` describes, not the requested range. A series flagged in many of its buckets is noisy, not unusual. Defaults to 0.1. Pass 1 to turn the filter off. A series with fewer than 10 scored buckets in its chart window is always shown, because its rate means little. `hidden_series` in the response counts the series it hid.

offset.description: Rows to skip in the sorted result. Pass the previous `offset` plus `limit` when `has_more` is true.

only_flagged.description: Only series, or insights, with at least one flagged bucket in the range. Set false to also list quiet ones.

order.description:
`unusual` puts flagged series first, and among them the series that flagged the smallest share of the scored buckets in the chart window of its interval, because a flag on a series that rarely flags is the surprising one. A series with fewer than 10 scored buckets in its chart window sorts after the series with a share. The chart window ends at `date_to` and does not follow `date_from`. `recent` puts the series whose newest flagged bucket ended last first, whatever its interval, so an hour flagged this morning sorts above a day flagged yesterday. Series whose flagged buckets ended at the same time sort as `unusual`. `rate` puts the highest `anomaly_rate` in the range first, then sorts as `unusual`. With `group_by: insight`, each insight sorts by its first series.

* `unusual` - Unusual
* `recent` - Recent
* `rate` - Rate

search.description: Only insights whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
